title: Tourist Season, 2006 · the next day
logline: The day after Wood draws the tourist kindly: the drawing's on the seawall in her hands and she's showing her husband, and the stick chorus in the back of every panel has an opinion, and Wood on the bench has the pad open to a blank page.

panels.composition: The seawall. A tourist showing her husband a drawing. WOOD on the bench with a blank pad. BARNABY under it. Along the bottom edge, the stick chorus, watching.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a tourist couple on a seawall looking at a small drawing while a thin man sits on a bench with a blank pad, a row of tiny stick figures along the bottom edge

panels.composition: The chorus, close: three stick figures, one with a tiny balloon.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, three tiny stick figures in a row with one holding up a tiny speech balloon
brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man on a bench looking down at the bottom edge of the panel

panels.composition: The pad, still blank. The dog asleep. The chorus gone from the bottom edge.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a blank sketch pad on a bench beside a sleeping dog with nothing along the bottom edge

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm
